captions.caption: Two soldiers in desert camouflage crouch near a brick wall and a metal gate.
One soldier kneels while the other stands slightly behind near the gated entrance.
The soldiers begin to move away from their positions near the brick wall.
Two soldiers run past the ornate metal gate in a dusty urban setting.
A soldier in full combat gear runs across the frame towards the left.
The camera pans left, showing a brick pillar and a partially visible gate.
The focus stays on the brick wall and the metal gate after soldiers pass.
A stationary shot shows the metal gate and brick pillars under bright light.
The camera remains fixed on the gated entrance and the ground in front.
A clear view of the decorative metal gate and the surrounding brickwork.
The scene is quiet with the gate closed and dust on the ground.
An explosion occurs behind the gate, sending a cloud of dust into the air.
Smoke and debris from the blast billow out from behind the metal gate.
The camera pans to reveal soldiers standing and kneeling along the street.
Multiple soldiers in desert camouflage are positioned near the gated compound.
A group of soldiers gathers and observes the area after the explosion.
Soldiers remain alert, holding their weapons in the dusty street.
A wide shot shows the soldiers spread out along the brick wall.
Soldiers are seen in various positions, some kneeling, near the gated entrance.
A soldier on a rooftop or elevated position looks through a scope.
The camera pans across a landscape featuring palm trees and several buildings.
A view from an elevated spot shows a residential area with many palm trees.
The camera continues to scan the horizon under a cloudy, bright sky.
Two soldiers stand on a rooftop, looking over a low wall at the surroundings.
A soldier on the roof prepares to fire a shoulder-mounted rocket launcher.
The soldier aims the launcher while another soldier stands nearby on the roof.
A large explosion occurs in the distance among the buildings and trees.
Smoke and fire from the distant blast rise high into the air.
The soldiers on the roof watch as the smoke from the explosion clears.
A shot of the rooftop shows the soldiers and a satellite dish in the foreground.
The scene shifts to a nighttime view with a dark and grainy appearance.
Bright flashes of light from tracer fire are visible against the dark sky.
Multiple glowing projectiles or small explosions light up the night.
A red flash briefly illuminates the horizon during the night sequence.
The dark landscape is seen with very little detail visible.
Another bright red flash appears in the distance against the night sky.
The flashes continue to light up the dark, cloudy sky intermittently.
A series of quick red flashes are seen in the distance at night.
The camera captures the dark sky with several small flashes of light.
A large, bright flash occurs, casting a red glow over the entire scene.
The nighttime scene fades back into darkness after the bright flash.
A soldier's silhouette is visible against the dark, nighttime sky.
The soldier moves slightly, his gear partially visible in the dim light.
More flashes of light from distant activity appear in the night.
A bright orange and red explosion lights up the nighttime horizon.
The glow from the explosion lingers before the scene returns to darkness.
The camera continues to record the dark landscape with occasional flashes.
Another quick flash of light is visible on the horizon at night.
The night scene remains dark with minimal activity visible.
A series of small, bright flashes are seen in the far distance.
A larger flash illuminates the sky, showing silhouettes of buildings.
The glow from the flash fades, and the scene becomes dark again.
The camera captures the dark sky with some faint background light.
Multiple bright flashes occur in rapid succession in the distance.
The flashes create a strobe-like effect against the dark night sky.
A bright red light pulses in the distance during the night.
The camera remains steady on the dark landscape with intermittent flashes.
A final bright flash is seen in the nighttime sky before the scene shifts.
The night sky is dark with some building structures seen in silhouette.
The video shows the dark nighttime scene with faint lights far away.
